text:
I want to die. I don’t want to hear any more bells.

The night comes undone, silence cracks.

If now a somber choir in an impossible low register,

if an impossible organ were to descend to where I am.


I want to die, and then it shouts at me: you are dying,

I want to close my eyes because I am so tired.

If there is no gaze, no gift to sustain me,

if they turn away, if they take, what do I expect from night.


I want to die now, as the flowers freeze,

while the silent stars labor in vain,

while the stopped clock does not torment the silence.


I want to die. I do not die.


I do not die. Perhaps

so many, so many collapses, so many deaths, perhaps,

so much forgetting, rejection,

so many gods who fled with cherished words

will not let me die for good.

translation.title: I Want to Die
